name: Free International Pub Crawl
description: A great way to meet fellow travelers and discover some of the city's best bars, ending with VIP entry to a club.
longDescription:
The Free International Pub Crawl offers an organized tour of central Porto's nightlife, designed to facilitate social interaction among international visitors. This event provides a structured opportunity to explore local establishments, culminating in club entry. It aims to introduce participants to a selection of bars and a club, fostering connections among travelers in a new city.

Participants can expect an evening lasting several hours, moving between different bar environments before concluding at a nightclub. The atmosphere is generally social and informal, catering to individuals interested in meeting new people and experiencing Porto's evening entertainment scene. The crawl is conducted in English, accommodating a diverse international audience.

This event is free of charge and typically welcomes walk-ins, though arriving early is advisable. The starting point is in central Porto, easily accessible via public transport, including the Trindade metro station, which is within a 5-minute walk of many central locations. Further specific meeting point details are usually provided upon registration or closer to the event date.
